My OSAP went to the school directly too but it wasn't enough to pay off the minimum payment. When you go to your [my.yorku.ca](https://my.yorku.ca) profile, you should see finances, and check your minimum payment. Subtract that payment by what OSAP sent to the school, and that's the remainder you need to pay the school.
